description:
Job Title: Denodo Developer

Location: Columbus, OH

Duration: Long-term

 

Technical/Functional Skills:

 

-  Denodo tool

-  Informatica

-  SQL

- Data Mapping

 

Experience Required:

 

-      Experience in developing data virtualization layer in denodo and generating reports

-      Information Security concepts and the ability to clearly define workable security architectures in virtual data views that support consuming applications and protect sensitive data

-      Experience in data blinding

-      Experience in sharing the knowledge, lessons learnt & best practices with the team

-      Understanding of agile methodologies

-      Retirement Plans Business domain knowledge

 

Roles & Responsibilities:

 

-       Lead  Developer role

-       Responsible for creating a data virtualization layer

-       Responsible for collaboration between technical     architecture and the offsite counterparts,

-      coordination with technical leads & SMEs,

-      defect triage,

-      system/performance test support,

-      Code deployment & quality assurance.

 

Generic Managerial/Soft Skills:

 

-          Willingness to work in a collaborative team environment

-          Experience in sharing the knowledge, lessons learnt & best practices with the team

-          Ability to mentor & groom any junior members in the team

-          Take up challenges & willingness to work in grey

-          Going above & beyond responsibilities to make Client organization & customer successful

-          Follow Client hierarchy as structured

 




 BS Degree


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
